source_of_truth: Operator directive 2026-06-10: develop Worktree Isolation v0 now, before Plan D, keeping v0 tight — per-plan git worktrees created from the correct base with recorded bindings (worktree_path, base_ref, branch, owner_actor); lock/build/close record the binding; plan-mutating commands refuse from the wrong worktree unless explicitly overridden; dashboard/operator brief show active worktrees with branch, dirty status, and actor; merge/close operates from the plan worktree and cleanup happens only when clean; dirty/untracked files are never deleted automatically — cleanup is explicit and audited. Out of scope: automatic conflict resolution, multi-machine coordination, agent leases/claims, background rebasing, deleting dirty worktrees, fully parallel orchestration.
completion_test: An operator can run `dontpanic plan worktree create <plan-id>` and get a dedicated worktree on a plan branch from a recorded base; running plan lock/close/disposition from any other working tree refuses (override-with-reason recorded); lock/audit/close capture the binding snapshot as evidence; `plan worktree list`, the operator brief, and the dashboard payload all show active worktrees with branch, dirty status, untracked count, actor, and broken bindings; `plan worktree remove` cleans up only a fully clean worktree with an audit entry and refuses dirty/untracked state with no force path; plan close never auto-removes.

user_journeys.name: isolated-plan-start
user_journeys.description: Operator binds a plan to its own worktree from a recorded base and works there without touching the main tree.

user_journeys.name: wrong-worktree-guard
user_journeys.description: A session in the wrong checkout tries a plan-mutating command and is refused with the bound path; an explicit override with reason proceeds and is recorded.

user_journeys.name: fleet-worktree-visibility
user_journeys.description: Operator sees every active worktree (branch, dirty, untracked, actor, broken) in the brief and dashboard.

user_journeys.name: safe-cleanup
user_journeys.description: Operator removes a finished plan's worktree; dirty/untracked state refuses with the file list and nothing is deleted.
